newsitem.title: USA: NY Power Authority to pursue Entergy pact.
newsitem.headline: NY Power Authority to pursue Entergy pact.

text.p: The New York Power Authority said it will continue to seek an agreement with Entergy Corp to operate the authority's two nuclear power plants.

In a statement responding to a Niagara Mohawk Power Corp and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp proposal to form a joint New York State nuclear operating company, NYPA said an Entergy agreement is "the best currently available means to derive maximum value from our nuclear power plants and provide savings to our customers."
It said the Nimo/RG&E proposal "has a familiar ring," pointing out NYPA porposed the idea almost three years ago.
At that time, the statement continued, there was little interest in the idea.
While the Nimo and RG&E do not say how long it will take them to form their proposed venture, NYPA said, "Entergy will effectively use the services of an operating company immediately."

It said the Entergy and utility proposals are not mutually exclusive. If the New York utilities succeed in forming the proposed venture, NYPA "will be free to join if we find it in the state's best interest."
